items.exampleEn: Rice and fish are the main ingredients of this dish.
items.exampleZh: 米和魚是這道菜的主要材料。

items.exampleEn: This ice cream comes in ten flavors.
items.exampleZh: 這種冰淇淋有十種口味。

items.exampleEn: We had a slice of lemon pie after dinner.
items.exampleZh: 晚餐後我們吃了一片檸檬派。

items.exampleEn: Dad likes to grill fish in the garden.
items.exampleZh: 爸爸喜歡在花園裡烤魚。

items.exampleEn: Good nutrition is important for growing children.
items.exampleZh: 良好的營養對成長中的孩子很重要。

items.exampleEn: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch.
items.exampleZh: 我做了一個鮪魚三明治當午餐。

items.exampleEn: My aunt runs a bakery in a small town.
items.exampleZh: 我阿姨在一個小鎮開麵包店。

items.exampleEn: We had a tasty meal at a small restaurant by the sea.
items.exampleZh: 我們在海邊一家小餐廳吃了一頓美味的餐點。

items.sentenceEn: Fresh ingredients make the food taste better.
items.sentenceZh: 新鮮的食材讓食物更好吃。

items.audioEn: The bakery sells fresh bread in the morning and cakes in the afternoon.
items.audioZh: 這家麵包店早上賣新鮮麵包，下午賣蛋糕。
items.questionZh: 這家麵包店下午賣什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Which flavor do you want, chocolate or strawberry?
items.sentenceZh: 你要哪種口味，巧克力還是草莓？

items.sentenceEn: Grilled corn is a popular snack at night markets.
items.sentenceZh: 烤玉米是夜市很受歡迎的小吃。

items.stemEn: Fruit and vegetables give us good ____.
items.stemZh: 水果和蔬菜帶給我們良好的營養。

items.stemEn: This soup is so ____ that I want another bowl.
items.stemZh: 這碗湯好喝到我還想再來一碗。

items.passageEn: Amy works part-time at a small bakery near her school. Every morning, she helps the owner choose the freshest ingredients. Their most popular item is a light and tasty tuna pie. The owner cares about nutrition, so she uses less sugar and more vegetables. On Fridays, Amy also helps grill sausages outside for customers. She writes every new flavor they try in a little notebook.
items.passageZh: Amy 在學校附近的一家小麵包店兼職。每天早上，她幫老闆挑選最新鮮的食材。店裡最受歡迎的是一種清爽又好吃的鮪魚派。老闆很在意營養，所以她少放糖、多放蔬菜。每個星期五，Amy 也幫忙在店外為客人烤香腸。她們每試一種新口味，她都會記在一本小筆記本裡。

questions.questionZh: 店裡最受歡迎的是什麼？

items.promptZh: 這家麵包店的麵包很好吃。
referenceEn: The bread at this bakery is very tasty.
This bakery's bread is really tasty.
rubricZh: tasty 表示「好吃的」，例如放在 be 動詞後、名詞前等
「這家麵包店的麵包」可寫 the bread at this bakery、this bakery's bread 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 這家餐廳只用本地的食材。
referenceEn: This restaurant only uses local ingredients.
This restaurant uses only local ingredients.
rubricZh: 用 ingredient 的複數表示「食材」（例如 local ingredients）
only 的位置不限（例如 only uses、uses only 等）
